name: mediwatch-ui
description: Dependency-free browser interface for the MediWatch educational monitoring workspace

scripts.format: prettier --write "web/**/*.{js,css,html}" "tests/**/*.js" playwright.config.js package.json ".github/**/*.yml" "docs/*.md" README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md
